messages:
Dana: quick note from today's bring-up of slim-rerank-2b int8 on holdout-news-2026. observed ndcg -2.0 pts vs fp16, mrr -0.01 absolute. the loss seems concentrated on medium-length queries (80-300 tokens).

Ravi: can you paste the eval args and quant/calib choices? medium-length sensitivity smells like calibration mismatch or runtime heuristics.

Dana: command:
```
./eval_rerank --model slim-rerank-2b --weights quant/int8-slim.ckpt --holdout holdout-news-2026 --seed 11 --batch 128 --report ndcg,mrr --slice medium
```
calibration: calib/global-5k-web (mixed lengths, heavy long-docs). runtime flags: pack_kv=auto, per_channel=true, eval_mode=off

Clara: using a calib heavy on long docs can compress logits for medium queries under symmetric scaling. also pack_kv=auto may have adjusted padding for the news holdout. first checks: candidate parity, token-length parity, and a quick ablation with pack_kv=false.

EvalBot: run-summary: run=6180301234 model=slim-rerank-2b-int8 ndcg_med=0.598 ndcg_all=0.612 mrr_med=0.379 seed=11 duration=58m

Dana: fp16 baseline -> ndcg_med=0.618 ndcg_all=0.632 mrr_med=0.389

Ravi: delta med ndcg = -0.020. Dana, please re-run two quick ablations: (1) int8 with calib_short (calibration sampled from medium-length docs), (2) int8 with pack_kv=false + eval_mode=true. keep seed.

EvalBot: run-started: 6180301241 variant=calib_med

EvalBot: run-started: 6180301243 variant=pack_off_eval_mode

Dana: quick results: calib_med -> ndcg_med=0.610 mrr_med=0.385; pack_off_eval_mode -> ndcg_med=0.616 mrr_med=0.388. pack_off almost recovers baseline.

Clara: interesting. both calibration and runtime heuristics matter. pack_off improved input parity so fewer truncation/padding differences. calib_med improved scale so logits preserve medium-query peaks.

Ravi: action items: 1) onboarding checklist: require calibration-length parity check (compute token-length hist KL between calib and holdout), 2) default eval runs to --eval-mode which disables pack/align heuristics, 3) add a CI smoke step to assert token-length parity < 0.5% mismatch.

Dana: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rerank-evals/pull/525 to add the parity check and default eval mode.

MetricsBot: created issue RNW-2177: add calib parity gate and eval-mode enforcement for quant onboarding.

EvalBot: note: attached top-k diffs and a short gist with layer-wise logit L2 per-token: https://gist.github.com/dana/med-calib-logit-diffs

Clara: one more suggestion: add a standard calibration-suite (short, medium, long) and require reporting of which suite was used in the quant artifact. makes reviews faster.

Ravi: agreed. I'll add a line to the bringup playbook and loop in QA to add the CI gate. good triage team.

Dana: thanks all. I'll re-run the full holdout tomorrow with locked pack_kv=false and calib_med, then finalize the onboarding report.
